title: 第10章威胁小舞，以后我就是老大-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    赵无极感知到嗜血魔剑吞噬鲜血的能力，脸色骤然一变，依靠强大的魂力，将这股吸力直接打断。

    随后，他抬手拍出一掌，猛地拍去。

    叶寒感知到掌劲，把视线转移回来，连忙抽出嗜血魔剑，横向一挡。

    砰！

    赵无极的手掌拍在嗜血魔剑上，爆发出一股恐怖的力量，将他连人带剑地轰飞了出去。

    不过，叶寒却并没有受伤，而是依靠熟练的卸力手法，卸掉了大半的力量。

    “好小子，难怪你的武魂必须见血，原来是这么回事。”

    “若是我不将你击退，我这一身鲜血恐怕就被你吸干了。”

    “既然我已经破例使用了魂技，这场比试，就算你赢了。”

    赵无极握着还在流血的胳膊，宣布叶寒顺利通过考核。

    叶寒的战力，已经得到了他的极度认可。

    “嗯！”

    叶寒点了点头，收齐了嗜血魔剑，退回了朱竹清的身边，将目光再次转移到小舞的身上，继续用火眼金睛探查她的情况。

    小舞注意到了他的眸光，内心深处突然涌现出一股莫名的感触，就好像他的眼睛能看穿她的身体，洞察她的一切。

    在这种眸光的注视下，小舞有点心虚的躲在唐三的身后。

    这时候，唐三也看到了叶寒的眸光，怒声谴责道：“叶寒，你这么盯着小舞看，是不是太无礼了。”

    叶寒似乎并没有听到他的话，依旧在盯着小舞看，好像要将她看穿。

    唐三见叶寒不甩他，怒火狂升，双拳紧握，恨得得走上去揍他一顿。

    如果不是他打不赢叶寒，早就直接动手了。

    朱竹清听到唐三那番话，也注意到了叶寒的举动，眉头微微一皱，掐了掐他腰间的肉，轻斥道：“叶寒大哥，你在看什么，这么盯着一个姑娘看，很不好的。”

    “没什么，我就是在看一只小兔子。”

    叶寒随便回了一句，收齐了火眼金睛。

    “兔子？”

    “哪儿有兔子？”

    朱竹清听闻，脸上满是疑惑。

    她看了一圈，也没有看到有兔子啊。

    叶寒指向小舞，说道：“就在那儿！”

    小舞闻言，脸色骤然一变。

    她知道，叶寒可能将她的身份看穿了。

    这要是被大家知道了她的真实身份，她会被杀死的。

    因为没有任何人能够抵挡得住十万年魂环和十万年魂骨的诱惑。

    “叶寒，你往哪儿看呢。”

    “那里是你能看的吗？”

    “还小兔子。”

    朱竹清误会了，以为叶寒说的小兔指的是那方面，双手叉腰，脸上满是醋意。

    “竹清，你没听明白。”

    “我是说，她是兔子变的。”

    叶寒知道朱竹清误会了，不慌不忙地做出解释。

    小舞听闻，脸都黑了，身体微微颤抖起来。

    完了！

    身份被他识破了。

    现在该怎么办。

    众人听到这番话，都愣住了。

    小舞是兔子变的？

    他在说啥胡话呢。

    活生生的一个人，怎么可能是兔子变的。

    “叶寒大哥，我看你是疯了。”

    “小舞是一个人，怎么可能是兔子变的。”

    “你就算是想多看她几眼，也不至于编出这么离谱的理由啊。”

    朱竹清无语了，果然男人没一个好货色。

    “叶寒，你少在这里血口喷人。”

    “小舞怎么可能是兔子变的。”

    “我跟小舞当了六年的同学，我怎么没发现。”

    “我告诉你，别把心思打在小舞的身上。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhao Wuji sensed the ability of the bloodthirsty demon sword to swallow blood, his expression suddenly changed, and he relied on his powerful soul power to directly interrupt the suction force.

Then, he raised his hand and slapped it away violently.

Ye Han felt the strength of his palm, turned his gaze back, quickly drew out the Bloodthirsty Demon Sword, and blocked it laterally.

Bang!

Zhao Wuji slapped his palm on the Bloodthirsty Demon Sword, and a terrifying force erupted, sending him flying away with both his body and sword.

However, Ye Han was not injured, but relied on skillful force-relieving techniques to remove most of his strength.

"Good boy, no wonder your martial spirit must see blood, so that's what happened."

"If I didn't repel you, I'm afraid you would have sucked all the blood out of me."

"Since I have made an exception and used my soul skill, you will win this competition."

Zhao Wuji held his still bleeding arm and announced that Ye Han had successfully passed the assessment.

Ye Han's combat prowess has been highly recognized by him.

"Hmm!"

Ye Han nodded, put away the bloodthirsty demon sword, and returned to Zhu Zhuqing's side. He turned his attention to Xiao Wu again and continued to explore her situation with his piercing eyes.

Xiao Wu noticed his gaze, and an inexplicable feeling suddenly emerged deep in her heart, as if his eyes could see through her body and see everything about her.

Under such gaze, Xiao Wu hid behind Tang San with a guilty conscience.

At this time, Tang San also saw Ye Han's eyes, and angrily condemned: "Ye Han, are you too rude to stare at Xiao Wu like this?"

Ye Han didn't seem to hear his words and was still staring at Xiao Wu, as if he wanted to see through her.

When Tang San saw that Ye Han wouldn't let him go, his anger rose wildly, his fists clenched, and he was so angry that he walked up and beat him up.

“If he hadn’t been unable to defeat Ye Han, he would have taken action directly.

When Zhu Zhuqing heard Tang San's words, he also noticed Ye Han's actions. He frowned slightly, pinched the flesh of his waist, and scolded: "Brother Ye Han, what are you looking at? It's not good to stare at a girl like this."

"It's nothing, I'm just looking at a little rabbit."

Ye Han replied casually, and his eyes were sharp.

"Rabbit?"

"Where is the rabbit?"

When Zhu Zhuqing heard this, his face was full of doubts.

She looked around and saw no rabbits.

Ye Han pointed at Xiao Wu and said, "It's right there!"

When Xiao Wu heard this, his expression suddenly changed.

She knew that Ye Han might have seen through her identity.

“If everyone knew her true identity, she would be killed.

Because no one can resist the temptation of a hundred thousand year soul ring and a hundred thousand year soul bone.

"Ye Han, where are you looking?"

"Is that where you can see?"

"Return the little rabbit."

Zhu Zhuqing misunderstood, thinking that the little rabbit Ye Han was talking about meant, so he put his hands on his hips and his face was full of jealousy.

"Zhuqing, you didn't understand."

"I mean, she turned into a rabbit."

Ye Han knew that Zhu Zhuqing had misunderstood, so he calmly explained.

When Xiao Wu heard this, his face turned dark and his body trembled slightly.

It’s over!

His identity was revealed.

What to do now.

When everyone heard these words, they were stunned.

Is Xiaowu transformed into a rabbit?

What nonsense is he talking about?

How could a living person be transformed into a rabbit?

"Brother Ye Han, I think you are crazy."

"Xiao Wu is a human being, how could he be transformed into a rabbit?"

"Even if you wanted to see her more, you wouldn't make up such an outrageous reason."

Zhu Zhuqing was speechless. As expected, men are not good at all.

"Ye Han, please stop being such a mouthful here."

"How could Xiao Wu be transformed into a rabbit?"

"Xiao Wu and I have been classmates for six years, why didn't I find out?"

"I tell you, don't focus on Xiao Wu."

title_en: Chapter 10: Threaten Xiao Wu, I will be the boss from now on - "Douluo V: Bind Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning and create a god-level family"
